'''Andrey Valerevich Kuznetsov''' is a Russian-American mechanical engineer and professor in the Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering at [[North Carolina State University]]. His research is in thermal sciences, fluid mechanics, porous media, nanofluids, bioconvection, and mathematical modeling in biological systems.<ref name="faculty">{{cite web
 |title=Andrey Kuznetsov
 |url=https://mae.ncsu.edu/people/avkuznet/
 |website=Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, North Carolina State University
 |access-date=8 May 2026
}}</ref>

== Education and career ==

Kuznetsov received a master's degree in mechanical engineering from [[Bauman Moscow State Technical University]] in 1988 and a master's degree in applied mathematics from [[Lomonosov Moscow State University]] in 1990. He earned a Ph.D. in mechanical engineering from the Mechanical Engineering Research Institute of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] in 1992.<ref name="cv">{{cite web
 |title=Andrey V. Kuznetsov curriculum vitae
 |url=https://www.mae.ncsu.edu/people/avkuznet/
 |website=North Carolina State University
 |access-date=8 May 2026
}}</ref>

He joined North Carolina State University in 1998 and is a professor in its Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering.<ref name="faculty" />

== Research ==

Kuznetsov's research has addressed convection and heat transfer in porous media, nanofluid transport, bioconvection, and biological transport modeling.<ref name="faculty" /><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Srikanth |first=Vishal |last2=Mallory |first2=Micah |last3=Ulmer |first3=Andrew J. |last4=Legant |first4=Wesley R. |last5=Kuznetsov |first5=Andrey V. |last6=Brudno |first6=Yevgeny |date=2026-07-21 |title=Hydrodynamic dispersion drives viral–cellular contact for gene delivery in porous media |url=https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.2603906123 |journal=Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences |volume=123 |issue=29 |article-number=e2603906123 |doi=10.1073/pnas.2603906123}}</ref> He has also co-edited academic books on heat transfer, fluid flow, and transport processes in biological media.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Becker |first=Sid M. |title=Transport in biological media |last2=Kuznetsov |first2=Andrey V. |date=2013 |publisher=Elsevier/Academic Press |isbn=978-0-12-415824-5 |location=Amsterdam Boston}}</ref><ref name="becker2015">{{cite book
